title: 第21章 出事了第22章 难民逃荒
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 箭矢离弦飞出，在空中发出阵阵炸响。
对面。
赵四跪在雪地里，脸上还带着扭曲和威胁的表情。
他甚至连反应的机会都没有。
只觉得视线中闪过一道乌黑的流光。
很快。
这道流光便狠狠撞在了他的胸口上。
狂暴的气血劲力，在接触到肉体的瞬间，直接彻底炸开了。
又是一团浓郁的血雾，在雪地里轰然绽放。
赵四的半个身子，瞬间被恐怖的力道给炸没了。
碎肉和断骨四下飞溅。
只剩下两具残破的尸体，躺在雪地上。
王大山站在原地，缓缓放下手中的胎铁大弓。
再去理会这两具破烂的尸体。
山里的野兽多的是。
血腥味很快就会把附近的狼群，或者野狗引过来。
用不了半天时间，这里就会连一块完整的骨头都剩不下。
就算天王老子来了，也查不出什么线索。
王大山转过身，朝着野猪走去。
走近了一看，才发现这野猪原来还真挺大的。
刚才隔着一段距离，看得还不算真切。
现在看着这庞大的体型，简直就像是一座小肉山。
粗糙的黑毛像钢针一样扎在厚实的皮肉上。
这重量，绝对超过了三百斤。
“怪不得，引来张三和赵四这两个地痞争抢抢”
王大山收回目光之后，飞快的盘算了一番。
这么大一头野猪，剥出来的肉。
要是弄到镇上去卖，能换来大把的白花花银子。
足够普通人家舒舒服服过上好几年了。
谁看了能不眼红。
他不再耽搁，走到野猪身侧，蹲下身子。
将野猪腹部花开放血。
气血中境的力量，让他现在干起这种体力活来，游刃有余。
动作极其熟练，没有丝毫拖泥带水。
干脆利落的将野猪剥皮拆肉。
大块的里脊，厚实的五花肉，还有强健的后腿。
被他一块块地分割下来。
找了几根结实的藤蔓，将这些上好的猪肉全部捆扎结实。
剩下的那些下水和骨头，他没打算带走。
正好留给山里的野兽，也能顺便掩盖一下尸体痕迹。
content_en:
"Collapse."
The arrow flew out from the string, making bursts of explosions in the air.
opposite.
Zhao Si was kneeling in the snow, with a twisted and threatening expression on his face.
He didn't even have a chance to react.
I just felt a black light flashing in my sight.
soon.
This stream of light hit his chest hard.
The violent qi and blood force exploded completely the moment it came into contact with the body.
"Bang."
Another thick mist of blood burst into bloom in the snow.
Half of Zhao Si's body was instantly blown away by the terrifying force.
Minced meat and broken bones flew everywhere.
Only two mangled bodies were left lying on the snow.
…
Wang Dashan stood on the spot and slowly put down the iron bow in his hand.
Pay no attention to these two tattered corpses anymore.
There are many wild animals in the mountains.
The smell of blood will quickly attract nearby wolves or wild dogs.
In less than half a day, not even a single intact bone will be left here.
Even if the King of Heaven comes, there won't be any clues.
…
Wang Dashan turned around and walked towards the wild boar.
After taking a closer look, I realized that this wild boar was really quite big.
Just now from a distance, I couldn't see it clearly.
Looking at this huge body now, it looks like a small mountain of meat.
The rough black hair stuck into the thick flesh like steel needles.
This weight definitely exceeds three hundred kilograms.
"No wonder it attracted two ruffians, Zhang San and Zhao Si, to fight over each other."
After Wang Dashan withdrew his gaze, he quickly calculated.
The meat from such a big wild boar.
If you get it and sell it in the town, you can get a lot of money.
It is enough for ordinary people to live comfortably for several years.
Who can watch this without being jealous?
…
Without further delay, he walked to the side of the wild boar and squatted down.
Open the belly of the wild boar to bleed.
The power of the middle level of qi and blood allows him to do this kind of physical work with ease now.
The movements are extremely skillful, without any sloppiness.
Skin the wild boar and remove the meat quickly.
Big chunks of tenderloin, thick pork belly, and strong hind legs.
It was divided piece by piece by him.
I found a few strong vines and tied all the good pork tightly.
He had no intention of taking away the remaining sewers and bones.
It's just for the wild beasts in the mountains, and it can also cover up the traces of corpses.
